name: Brick Wall’s Fortitude
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric 2, druid 2, magus 2, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a piece of brick)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The subject is able to withstand tougher hardships. The spell grants a +3 resistance bonus to Fortitude saves. This bonus increases by +1 for every 3 caster levels beyond 3rd level to a maximum of +5 at 9th level. This bonus does not stack with other resistance bonuses.
